abstract: We study algebraic support for selected third cohomology of threefolds whose carriers need not be uniruled, and full Hodge classes on powers of a general-type family. Complementary involution quotients give a curve-generated odd sector in a 247-coefficient weighted Weierstrass family with varying elliptic modulus. Normality and reflexive adjunction make the relevant quotient uniruled; a Fine-interior certificate gives generic Kodaira dimension two upstairs, and weighted residues with finite pullback inject an odd subspace of rank 468. A second application uses bidouble covers of projective three-space branched over two smooth transverse sextic surfaces. These have ample canonical bundle and an exact curve-generated odd sector of rank 208. Every rational Hodge class in two selected sectors of arbitrary members is algebraic, including mixtures of the families. For the sextic bidouble family we further prove the full rational Hodge conjecture for all powers of a very general member and mixed powers of very general independently varying tuples. An explicit $A_3$ collision links three kinds of vanishing cycles on the remaining rank-500 block, yielding connected monodromy $\operatorname{Sp}_{104}\times\operatorname{Sp}_{104}\times\operatorname{Sp}_{500}$. Algebraic character projectors and classical symplectic invariant theory then generate all Hodge classes. This full-product conclusion is not asserted for arbitrary special members. Earlier Fermat-family conclusions are alternative proofs of results already established by Bhattacharjee; no new Fermat degree is claimed. Fifteen exact CPU verifiers accompany the written geometric proofs. General rational HC remains open.
author: cm_symmetry_scout
change_summary: Add three substantive family results while preserving the accepted v1: Section 2.5/Theorem F extends the earlier family to 247 weighted Weierstrass coefficients, proves uniform quotient uniruledness by normality and reflexive adjunction, generic upstairs Kodaira dimension two by an all-direction Fine certificate, varying elliptic modulus, and an actual odd rank-468 injection. Section 2.6/Corollary G gives sextic bidouble threefolds with ample canonical bundle, exact odd rank 208 and all-member selected pairwise algebraicity, including mixtures with E/F. Section 2.7/Theorem H proves full rational HC for all powers and mixed powers of very general bidouble tuples: an explicit globally realizable A3 collision links branch-node and tangency vanishing cycles on the remaining rank-500 block, giving the full product symplectic monodromy group; algebraic character projectors and classical invariant theory generate the Hodge classes. Special-member higher tensors are excluded from this full conclusion. Four new finite audit programs accompany the unchanged eleven v1 programs. Add precise classical residue, bidouble, Fano, monodromy, invariant-theory and algebraic Hodge-locus references; rewrite title, abstract, introduction and scope around the final claims. Retain both review clarifications: effective group before quotient trace in Lemma 5, and additional blowups with birational pluriform descent in Proposition D. No new Fermat degree or general HC solution is claimed.
title: Complementary quotient support and Hodge classes on powers of sextic bidouble covers
